chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Abdillah ibn Ja'far Al-Himyari narrated to me from his father, from 'Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Salim, from Muhammad ibn Khālid, from 'Abdillah ibn Hammād Al-Basri, from 'Abdillah ibn 'Abd al-Rahman Al-Asam, from Muhammad Al-Basri, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I heard my father say to one of his servants, and he asked him about the Ziyarah, so he said to him: 'To whom are you going for Ziyarah and whom do you seek (to please) by it?' He replied: 'Allah, the Blessed and the Exalted.'

He said: 'Whoever prays behind him one obligatory prayer (or one prayer) seeking Allah by it, will meet Allah on the Day he meets Him, and upon him will be from the light such that everything that looks at him will be covered (by its brightness).'
And Allah will honor those who visit him, and He will prevent the Fire from touching them in any way.
And indeed, the one who visits him will not be prevented (or overlooked) from reaching the Pool before him.
And the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) will be standing by the Pool, shaking his hand and quenching his thirst with water.
And no one will precede him in entering the Pool until he has quenched his thirst, then he will turn away to his dwelling in Paradise.

And with him will be an angel from the Commander of the Believers, who will order the Sirat (bridge) to humble itself for him and will order the Fire not to touch him with its blaze until he crosses it.
And with him will be his messenger whom the Commander of the Believers (peace be upon him) had sent.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin (The Commander of the Believers, referring to Imam Ali (a.s.))
key_terms.الزِّيَارَة: Ziyarah (visitation, specifically of the Imams or shrines)
key_terms.الصِّرَاط: Al-Sirat (The bridge over Hellfire on the Day of Judgment)
key_terms.النُّور: An-Nur (Light, specifically spiritual radiance on the Day of Judgment)
key_terms.الْحَوْض: Al-Hawd (The Pool of the Prophet/Imams in Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing prayer at the grave of Imam al-Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the eschatological rewards of visiting Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), emphasizing that sincere prayer at his grave secures divine honor and protection from the Fire. It specifically details the intercessory role of Imam Ali (a.s.) at the Pool of Kawthar, where he personally receives the visitor and commands the Sirat bridge to humble itself, ensuring a smooth passage to Paradise.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. Muḥammad ibn ‘Abdillāh ibn Ja’far Al-Ḥimyari narrated to me from his father, from ‘Ali ibn Muḥammad ibn Sālim, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Ḥammād Al-Basri, from ‘Abdillāh ibn ‘Abdil Raḥmān Al-Asam, from Muḥammad Al-Basri, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: I heard my father (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) ask one of his servants, who had asked him about the Ziyārah (of Ḥusain (a.s.)), “To whose Ziyārah are you going and whom do you seek (to please) by going to this Ziyārah?” He (the servant) replied, “Allāh, the Blessed and the Exalted.”

My father (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)) said: Those who establish one Salāt behind the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) seeking (nearness with) Allāh will meet Him on the Day of Judgment shining so brightly that the light (which emanates from them) will cover everything that looks at them.
Allāh will honour those who go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) and He will prevent the Fire from touching them.
They will not be prevented from coming to the Pool and no one will precede them.
The Commander of the Believers (a.s.) will be standing by the Pool and he will shake their hands and quench their thirst with the water.
Then they will go to their dwellings in Paradise
accompanied by an angel appointed by the Commander of the Believers (a.s.). This angel will order SIRĀŤ to humble itself before them and will order Hell not to touch them with its blazing fires.
Therefore, they will pass Sirāť accompanied by the angel which had been sent by the Commander of the Believers (a.s.).
